title: Udaan - District Interact Conference
summary: District Project UDAAN has been a beautiful reminder of what we can achieve when we work together with a shared purpose.
description:
District Project UDAAN has been a beautiful reminder of what we can achieve when we work together with a shared purpose. Our Platinum Co-host recognition, 1st Prize for Maximum Participation of Parent Club, and the outstanding performances of our students have made us all proud!

Pawar Public School– 1st Prize in Dance and 2nd Prize in PPT
RVES – 1st Prize in PPT and 2nd Prize in Dance
Heartiest congratulations to both schools, their teachers and all the talented students who made us proud ! A heartfelt thank you to PP Sunita Hirlekar and Rtn. Vikas Hirlekar for their unwavering commitment and dedication. They are constantly by the schools’ side, investing their valuable time, guiding the teachers and students, and ensuring that our projects move forward smoothly and successfully. Their dedication and quiet, consistent efforts are truly the backbone of our Youth projects.

Thanks to our President Vrajesh, R/Ann Anjum, & PP Prithika for taking time to be present and cheer our students
